1.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo, Mose na Aroni baragenda babwira Farawo bati “Uwiteka Imana y'Abisirayeli, aravuze ngo ‘Rekura ubwoko bwe bugende, bumuziriririze umunsi mukuru mu butayu.’ ”

2.text: Farawo arababwira ati “Uwiteka ni nde, ngo numvire ndeke Abisirayeli? Sinzi Uwiteka, kandi ntabwo narekura Abisirayeli.”

3.text: Baramubwira bati “Imana y'Abaheburayo yaratubonekeye, none turakwinginze reka tujye mu butayu, tugendemo urugendo rw'iminsi itatu, dutambirireyo Uwiteka Imana yacu ibitambo, itadutera ikatwicisha mugiga cyangwa inkota.”

4.text: Umwami wa Egiputa arababwira ati “Mose na Aroni, ni iki gitumye murekesha abo bantu imirimo yabo? Nimusubire mu buretwa bwanyu.”

5.text: Kandi Farawo ati “Dore abantu bo mu gihugu baragwiriye, none mubaruhuye uburetwa bwabo.”

6.text: Kuri uwo munsi Farawo ategeka abakoresha ubwo bwoko uburetwa, n'abatware bo muri bo ati

7.text: “Ntimwongere guha abantu inganagano zo kubumbisha amatafari nka mbere, nibagende bishakire inganagano.

8.text: Kandi umubare w'amatafari basanzwe babumba bawugumeho, mwe kuwubagabanirizaho na make kuko ari abanebwe. Ni cyo kibatakisha bati ‘Tugende dutambire Imana yacu ibitambo.’

9.text: Abo bagabo bategekwe imirimo irushaho kurushya, bayikore be kwita ku magambo y'ibinyoma.”

10.text: Abakoresha ubwo bwoko uburetwa basohokana n'abatware bo muri bo, babwira abantu bati “Farawo aravuze ngo ‘Ntabaha inganagano.

11.text: Nimugende mwishakire inganagano aho mwazibona, kuko mutari bugerurirwe umubare mwaciwe na hato.’ ”

12.text: Nuko abantu bakwizwa mu gihugu cya Egiputa cyose no kwishakira ibitsinsi by'inganagano mu cyimbo cy'inganagano.

13.text: Kandi ababakoresha uburetwa babatera umwete bati “Mumare umubare mwaciwe w'uburetwa bw'iminsi yose, nk'uko musanzwe mukora.”

14.text: Abatware bo mu Bisirayeli, abo abakoresha uburetwa ba Farawo bahaye gutwara barakubitwa, barababaza bati “Ni iki cyatuye mudasohoza umubare mwaciwe ejo na none, ntimwuzuze amatafari nka mbere?”

15.text: Maze abatware bo mu Bisirayeli baragenda batakira Farawo bati “Ni iki gitumye utugirira utya abagaragu bawe?

16.text: Abagaragu bawe nta nganagano duhabwa, maze bakatubwira ngo tubumbe amatafari kandi dore abagaragu bawe turakubitwa, ariko abantu bawe ni bo urubanza ruriho.”

17.text: Arababwira ati “Muri abanebwe, muri abanebwe, ni cyo kibavugisha muti ‘Tugende dutambire Uwiteka ibitambo.’

18.text: Nuko none nimugende mukore, kuko ari nta nganagano muzahabwa, ariko muzajye mwuzuza umubare w'amatafari.”

19.text: Abatware bo mu Bisirayeli bamenya ko babonye ishyano, kuko babwiwe ko batazica umubare w'amatafari babumba ho na muke w'uburetwa bwabo bw'iminsi yose.

20.text: Bavuye kwa Farawo bahura na Mose na Aroni, bahagaze mu nzira,

21.text: barababwira bati “Uwiteka abarebe abacire urubanza kuko mutumye Farawo n'abagaragu be batwanga urunuka, mukabaha inkota yo kutwica.”

22.text: Mose asubira ku Uwiteka aramubaza ati “Mwami, ni iki gitumye ugirira nabi ubwo bwoko? Ni iki cyaguteye kuntuma?

23.text: Kuko uhereye aho nagiriye kwa Farawo, nkavugana na we mu izina ryawe, agirira nabi ubwo bwoko, nawe nta cyo wabakijije na gito.”
